summary.root_cause_text: Payment provider calls to internal://payments-v1 are timing out, so the worker marks orders processed without recording a payment. The reason for the timeouts is unknown, and no config or deploy change explains it.
recommended: Check the health of the payment provider (payments-v1) and its network path, and confirm the correct provider URL.
If a valid alternate provider URL is confirmed, set payment_provider_url to it. A restart is not needed.
Once payments succeed, run reprocess_orders with all_unpaid. It never double-charges.
Consider pausing order intake until payments work, because orders are being marked processed without payment.
